name: Wellspring River
summary: In Teldrassil, Wellspring River carries water north from Wellspring Lake and over the World Tree's edge to the sea. Timberlings along its banks have grown dangerous.

sections.title: Waters of the World Tree
sections.body:
Wellspring River runs north from Wellspring Lake through Teldrassil's forest. At the edge of the great tree, its waters plunge to the sea below.

The riverbanks have grown unsafe. Timberlings there have gone crazed, attacking travelers and druids who come near the water.

faq.q: Where does the Wellspring River lead?
faq.answer: Wellspring River flows north from Wellspring Lake to the edge of Teldrassil's canopy. There, it plunges in a great waterfall to the ocean below.

faq.q: Why are the timberlings along the river attacking people?
faq.answer: Timberlings along Wellspring River have grown erratic and crazed, and attack anyone nearby. Their unrest alarms the local night elven druids.

faq.q: Where does the water in the river come from?
aliases: where does wellspring water come from
faq.answer: Wellspring River flows from Wellspring Lake. A natural freshwater spring deep within the living trunk and boughs of the World Tree feeds the lake.

angles.text: As a druid, the maddened timberlings along Wellspring River are an unsettling sign of sickness spreading through Teldrassil's ecosystem.
As a night elf, you know the freshwater waterways flowing from Teldrassil's heart represent the vitality of the Kaldorei's new home. Unrest along their banks is deeply concerning.
